# appgatesdp_sites_resources (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `resolver` (String) Resolver type to query.
- `type` (String) Resource type to query.

### Optional

- `query` (String) Query string to filter the result list. It's used for various fields depending on the object type. Send multiple query parameters to make the queries more specific.
- `range` (String) 'Range string to limit the result list. Format: -. 3-10 means the items between the (including) 3rd and the 10th
 will be returned. Defaults to all objects.'
- `value` (String) Optional parameter to search for values. Used with "...-tag-values" types.

### Read-Only

- `data` (List of String) List of queries resources.
- `descending` (Boolean) Whether the sorting is applied descending or ascending.
- `filter_by` (Attributes List) The filters applied to the list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter_by))
- `gateway_name` (String) The name of the Gateway which returned the result.
- `order_by` (String) The field name used to sort the list.
- `queries` (List of String) The queries applied to the list.
- `total_count` (Number) The total readable count of entities. Not influenced by the query.

### Nested Schema for `filter_by`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The field name the filter is applied to.
- `value` (String) The value used for comparison.
